{"id": "32:4", "words": "todos os seus caminhos são juízos", "readings": ["all his ways are judgments (acts of justice)", "all his ways are good sense / sound judgment ('juízo' = sanity, prudence)"], "likelyHeard": "judgments, but the sense of a 'way' being a 'judgment' is unclear"},
{"id": "32:5", "words": "Pecaram contra ele, e não são filhos seus nas imundícies", "readings": ["they sinned against him and, because of their filth, are no longer his children", "they are not his children who live in filth (others are)", "in their filth they are not his children (but otherwise are)"], "likelyHeard": "they sinned and are not his children, with 'nas imundícies' left hanging; subject of 'pecaram' (who sinned?) not audible"},
{"id": "32:7", "words": "que te possuiu", "readings": ["who acquired / owns you (as his possession)", "who possessed you (sexual or demonic possession sense)"], "likelyHeard": "owned you, but the verb has an uncomfortable secondary sense in Brazilian usage"},
{"id": "32:12", "words": "Jacó, a corda da sua herança", "readings": ["Jacob is the measuring line (allotted portion) of his inheritance", "Jacob is a rope/cord belonging to his inheritance (literal rope)"], "likelyHeard": "a literal rope; the measuring-line image is not audible"},

{"id": "32:14", "words": "a menina do seu olho", "readings": ["the apple of God's own eye", "the pupil of Jacob's eye"], "likelyHeard": "God's, by the idiom 'menina dos olhos'"},
{"id": "32:15", "words": "provoca os seus filhotes a voar", "readings": ["urges / stirs the chicks to fly", "provokes / irritates the chicks"], "likelyHeard": "urges them to fly"},

{"id": "32:17", "words": "não havia com ele deus estranho", "readings": ["there was no foreign god with the Lord (helping him)", "there was no foreign god with Jacob (among the people)"], "likelyHeard": "with the Lord"},

{"id": "32:20", "words": "carneiros, filhos de Basã", "readings": ["the rams are from Bashan", "both lambs and rams are 'sons of Bashan'", "'filhos de Basã' are a separate item, people or animals"], "likelyHeard": "animals from a place called Basã, though the place is unknown"},
{"id": "32:21", "words": "E bodes com o tutano do trigo", "readings": ["goats together with the finest wheat ('marrow of wheat' = choicest grain)", "goats that have wheat marrow (stuffed/fed with wheat)"], "likelyHeard": "an obscure image; 'tutano do trigo' is not understood as finest wheat"},
